name: @eetr/agent-streemr

hlido_opinion.headline: Robust framework for agent evaluation and streaming — ideal for developers but lacks extensive public documentation.
hlido_opinion.body: The @eetr/agent-streemr framework stands out for its solid performance in agent evaluation and streaming capabilities. It is designed with developers in mind, providing a structured approach to building and assessing agent behaviors. However, while the core functionality is impressive, the lack of extensive public documentation may pose challenges for new users trying to leverage its full potential. The framework's high score reflects its reliability and effectiveness in its intended use cases, but it would benefit greatly from improved accessibility and support materials. As it stands, @eetr/agent-streemr is a strong choice for those familiar with agent frameworks, but newcomers may find the learning curve steep.

tier_rationale: STEADY (90) due to its strong performance and reliability in agent evaluation, supported by a solid user base. It remains not VITAL because of the limited public documentation which may hinder broader adoption. Improved documentation could elevate its tier significantly.
